thesisQuality.basis: Large strategic domestic lithium project has credible demand/financing but no operating production yet.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: About $1.3B cash/restricted cash supports construction, offset by tariff/capex pressure and pre-revenue status.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep. 21 market cap about $1.08B offers plausible project-value headroom, tempered by execution and dilution uncertainty.

catalystScore.basis: Late-2027 mechanical completion target and Q4 2026 power energization are identifiable material milestones.

governancePower.basis: Strategic financing execution and disclosure are constructive, but evidence is insufficient for strong-band stewardship claims.

alignment2036.basis: Domestic lithium supply is foundational to battery and storage supply-chain resilience across plausible electrification futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core value remains concentrated in one major project and lithium end-market despite multiple strategic counterparties.

bottleneckControl.basis: Thacker Pass represents scarce large-scale domestic lithium capacity, but control is not yet proven through qualified output.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Strategic financing improves resilience, while lithium-price, construction and commissioning dependence leave meaningful concentration.

substitutionResilience.basis: Lithium remains important across battery pathways, but alternative suppliers/projects and chemistry intensity shifts constrain stronger treatment.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Domestic location supports geographic resilience, but construction logistics, labor, tariffs and fabrication dependencies remain material.

pricingPower.basis: Strategic scarcity supports potential value capture, but no operating margin or demonstrated price pass-through exists pre-production.

riskEvidence.basis: Material construction cost/schedule, commissioning, lithium-price and dilution/capital-structure risks remain before commercial output.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Primary issuer evidence is current and identity is validated; independent valuation evidence is current, but operating claims remain issuer-heavy and project-stage unknowns persist.

scoreRecord.thesis: Thacker Pass can become strategically important domestic lithium supply if financed construction converts into qualified commercial output; current valuation leaves plausible upside but execution remains the dominant uncertainty.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Construction/commissioning slippage or adverse lithium economics can erode project value before cash generation, with financing complexity adding dilution risk.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q4 2026 targeted power energization, followed by updated capital/construction disclosures toward late-2027 mechanical completion.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore records weighted component score less methodology risk penalty; confidence is separately reported and remains above publishable minimum.
